description: Synthetic, not captured: deck 1 plays song A from 30 s, loops 4 beats at 126 BPM three times, seeks forward, is pitched +6%; deck 2 starts song B under a closed crossfader, the crossfader sweeps to deck 2, the master follows at the middle; deck 1 pauses, is cued while paused, ejected, loads song C, plays it from 5 s, and the crossfader comes back to the middle. Wire format and delta semantics of the VDJ 8.5.9307 captures, elapsed only (no beatpos or remaining); arrival jitter 0..8 ms, every 97th write 24 ms late. The last meta record holds the model's expectations in set time (from deck 1's first play): [setMs, deck, song, songMs, level, dominant, running, label]. Generator: gen_djset_mix.py in the DJSET notes.
note: t = ms; rx data is raw, unparsed
